scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof for all primes and explicit complete characteristic-23 finite-field factor computations. Reproducibility does not constitute independent audit. No novel claim is made about the earlier four-or-zero p-rank dichotomy.
scientific_limitations: Classifies a-number and p-rank of the specified smooth pencil; does not give full Ekedahl--Oort types, arbitrary-prime gcd degrees, or unrelated moduli families. Earlier results supply the superspecial gcd criterion and inversion isomorphism criterion.
title: The thirteen nonordinary genus-four dihedral-quintic parameters in characteristic \(23\)
